plan.analysis: Inclusion is the weak class (recall 0.33, 120/179 missed) and the misses are tiny faint vertical streaks (median 33.5px vs 90.5px train; low-size tertile recall only 0.27). Round 2's small-scale any_class pastes lifted it 0.27->0.33, so keep that recipe but raise the floor to 0.4 so pastes stay learnable and add the faint source 297 for the low-contrast misses. Patches (0.65) and scratches (0.56) misses are also small (54px / 42px); scratches actually dropped last round when pushed to 0.3-0.8, so I lift its floor to 0.5-1.0 and restrict to thin line sources (rotation covers the horizontal misses). Patches get a mid-small range and blob sources matching the dark missed blobs. Allocation keeps inclusion below the ~80 diminishing-return zone (70 cumulative) while still feeding the other two classes so the shared detector doesn't starve them.
plan.rationale: Keep the small-paste strategy that worked for inclusion but with a 0.4 floor for learnability and the faint 297 source; fix scratches' regression by using a 0.5-1.0 range on thin line sources (rotation yields the horizontal misses); give patches mid-small dark-blob pastes. 20/15/15 respects the 50 budget, headroom, the 105 cap, and avoids pushing inclusion past ~80 cumulative.
